name: Idempotent Replay
description: Replaying the same operation twice produces the same result. Every operation is idempotent — the foundation for safe re-delivery and replay-based sync.
purpose: Ensure re-delivery and replay-based sync are safe by making every operation idempotent — applying it twice is equivalent to applying it once.
acceptanceCriteria: Every operation type is provably idempotent: applying it twice produces the same final state as applying it once.
Operation handlers include idempotency checks (e.g., dedup by operation ID).
Replay-driven sync uses operation IDs to skip already-applied operations.
Idempotency is tested with at-least-once delivery scenarios.
Non-idempotent operations are explicitly flagged and wrapped to become idempotent.
